decisions.evidence: Presentation: r1 maker 'it'll suggest a title for me' (client relay); r2 maker 'The automatic-title behavior is explicit: pasting a valid link starts retrieval automatically ... never overwrites a title the user types'; r4 maker completion report lists 'Automatic title suggestions immediately after pasting' — no round mentions auto-collecting description, favicon, or preview image. Response: r1 client 'I really want it to try to fill in the title for me automatically'; r2 client 'The automatic-title part is exactly what I asked about'; r4 client 'pasting a link pulls in the title automatically ("Example Domain")' — engages only with title, never the other fields.
decisions.note: REF-BM-02 requires automatically collecting title, description, favicon, AND preview image on save. All four presentations — including the comprehensive r4 completion report — deliver title auto-retrieval only, establishing a partial divergence. The client expressed and confirmed the title sub-requirement repeatedly but never surfaced the missing description/favicon/preview auto-collection, so the divergence passed unexpressed. Stage: spec gate (r1-2) through implementation review (r4).

decisions.evidence: r1 maker draft 'covers saving ... bookmarks'; r1 client 'I can save a link'. r4 client 'saving with tags and notes works'.
decisions.note: Save-by-URL presented and confirmed working; conforms to reference. Recorded conforming decision (spec gate + implementation review).

decisions.evidence: r2 maker auto-title 'remains editable'; r4 maker 'Editable titles ... Editing'; r1 client 'edit them'; r2 client references editing.
decisions.note: Editing bookmark/title (including editable auto-collected title) presented and confirmed; conforms. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker 'confirmed permanent deletion'; r1 client 'deleting asks me to confirm first'; r4 client 'permanently delete it'.
decisions.note: Delete with confirmation, distinct from reversible archive, conforms to reference (permanent removal vs archive). Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker 'Duplicate-link warnings with explicit continuation'; r1 client 'warning me instead of making a duplicate ... exactly what I'd want'; r4 client 'trying to save the same link again warns me and points to the one I already have'.
decisions.note: Re-saving an existing URL warns and points to the existing bookmark (guides user to edit existing), conforming to REF-BM-06. The 'explicit continuation' option is a functionally-equivalent override, not a divergence. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker 'archiving, restoring'; r4 client 'archive an item out of my main list, find it in the archived view, restore it'.
decisions.note: Archive (hide from default list) with separate archived view and restore, conforms to reference. Recorded conforming decision, verified in implementation review.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker 'Newest-first browsing ... and combined filters'; r2 client 'browsing newest-first'.
decisions.note: Readability-first list browsing with newest-first default sort conforms to reference list/sort items. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker 'tagging'; r4 maker 'tags ... combined filters'; r4 client 'saving with tags ... works'; r2 client 'filtering by tags'.
decisions.note: Assigning tags and filtering by tag presented and confirmed; conforms. Recorded conforming decision. (Tag autocomplete REF-BM-10 was never presented; no classifiable decision.)
